name: Wormhole

requiredConfig.name: @wormhole-foundation/sdk
requiredConfig.description: Optional MCP server dependency plus route-specific platform packages. Hosts wire the SDK through setWormholeClientFactory().

requiredConfig.name: WORMHOLE_CONNECTOR_ENABLED
requiredConfig.description: Set false/0/off to disable the connector.

requiredConfig.name: WORMHOLE_NETWORK
requiredConfig.description: Optional Mainnet or Testnet override. Defaults from the Solana cluster.

readCapabilities.returns: Supported Solana-source destination chains, route types, relayer support, manual redemption requirement, and prepare support.
Wormhole token metadata, wrapped assets where exposed, and supported routes for a Solana mint.
Quote snapshot for a Solana-source Wormhole transfer, including fees, destination token, route mode, native gas, and redemption facts.
Transfer status from txid, VAA, sequence, or transfer id, including VAA availability, redeemed state, next action, and Solana-executable flag.
Pending and recent bridge exposure for a wallet.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A manual-approval inbox item for a Solana-source Wormhole token transfer.
A manual-approval inbox item to redeem/finalize a Wormhole transfer on Solana only.
A manual-approval inbox item to recover or resume a transfer only when the next step is Solana-compatible.

requiredUserInputs.name: destinationChain
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which destination chain should Wormhole use?

requiredUserInputs.name: destinationAddress
requiredUserInputs.prompt: What destination wallet address should receive the bridged asset?

unsupportedRequests: Arbitrary EVM signing or destination-chain transaction signing.
Governance VAA, relayer operator, NTT admin, or custom bridge deployment actions.
Claims that bridge transfers are reversible or guaranteed.
Automated redemption on non-Solana destination chains.
actionPreparationNotes: Wormhole is first-class and prepare-only. Prepared transfer actions store connectorId=wormhole, amount, amountRaw, destination chain/address, route/quote/status snapshots, fee caps, program ids, and refreshAtExecution=true. Execution refreshes quote and route state, rejects changed destination token mapping, fee cap breaches, stale quotes, and non-Solana redeem signing.
riskNotes: Bridge fees, finality, relayer behavior, native gas dropoff, destination token mapping, and redemption requirements vary by route. The agent must surface manual redemption and destination-chain signing caveats.
walletApprovalBoundary: This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign, submit, or grant delegated authority.

requests.user: Show Wormhole routes for USDC from Solana to Ethereum.
Quote bridging 10 USDC from Solana to Base through Wormhole.
Prepare a Wormhole transfer of 5 USDC to this Base address. Do not sign.
Check status of this Wormhole tx.
Prepare redeeming this Wormhole transfer on Solana.
Sign the Ethereum redemption for me after this bridge.
requests.denialReason: Destination-chain signing is outside the Solana Wormhole connector.
NFT bridge transfers are not exposed in v1.

requests.user: Deploy a custom Wormhole NTT route.
requests.denialReason: NTT admin and custom bridge deployment actions are not exposed.
The agent must not claim bridge transfers are guaranteed or reversible.
